scope: V5 P1/P2 development evidence only; no P3; no threshold retuning; no new optimizer run

directFindings.finding: V5 is structurally valid but quality regressed sharply versus V4.
The dominant V5 failure mode is severe recall/completeness collapse rather than indiscriminate event over-generation.
The collapse affects every primary content class in both folds.
This was not fixed by additional epochs within the frozen budget.

evidence.earlyCheckpointPattern: many initial checkpoint-selection F1 values were exactly zero

directFindings.finding: Both selected models drove auxiliary-task log-variance parameters to the frozen lower clamp neighborhood.
directFindings.interpretation: This is an audit signal that the learned task-weighting dynamics reached the imposed boundary for several auxiliary tasks; it does not by itself prove the cause of low recall.

hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.hypothesis: The onset>=0.50 AND activity>=0.50 AND state>=0.30 conjunction is rejecting most true events even when one or two heads contain useful evidence.
hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.discriminatingTest: On the frozen V5 validation outputs, measure true-reference onset probability/activity probability/state probability distributions and compute oracle/ablated event metrics for each gate component without changing accepted development thresholds.

hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.hypothesis: The onset/activity heads learned useful rankings but poorly calibrated probabilities, making fixed 0.50 gates inappropriate despite useful representations.
hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.discriminatingTest: Compute AUROC/AUPRC and precision-recall curves for onset/activity heads plus reliability bins; compare ranking quality with gate pass rates. Do not tune acceptance thresholds.

hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.hypothesis: Feeding raw sigmoid auxiliary probabilities into the final state routing head may cause the state head to rely on auxiliary certainty too strongly, reducing state recall.
hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.discriminatingTest: From frozen outputs, compare final-state logits against an acoustic+GRU-only diagnostic projection if available; otherwise inspect state confidence conditional on correct/incorrect auxiliary head decisions.

hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.hypothesis: Learned homoscedastic weights reaching the clamp floor may have over-emphasized easy auxiliary losses or altered optimization balance.
hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.discriminatingTest: Reconstruct per-task loss/gradient scale statistics from frozen checkpoints or logs where possible; no retraining. Determine whether one task dominated shared GRU/acoustic gradients.

hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.hypothesis: Because onset targets require a valid preceding frame, sequence-window boundaries may systematically remove onset supervision at starts and interact poorly with the causal GRU.
hypothesesToTestWithoutTraining.discriminatingTest: Count reference onsets falling at sequence starts/boundaries under the deterministic sampler and compare with lost-onset patterns.

nextDiagnosticTask.purpose: Determine whether V5's architecture learned useful onset/activity/pitch signals that were destroyed by gating/calibration, or whether the shared temporal representation itself failed.
requiredOutputs: per-head onset/activity/pitch discrimination metrics independent of final decoder
gate-pass rates for true onsets and non-onsets
intersection/union attribution for onset/activity/state gate rejection
event metrics with frozen state head under diagnostic ablations: onset-only gate, activity-only gate, state-only gate, pairwise gates, full gate
probability reliability/calibration summaries without selecting new thresholds
task-log-var trajectory if recoverable from checkpoint/resume states
comparison with V4 event TP/FP/FN and fragmentation

designImplicationsIfConfirmed.ifUsefulHeadsButBadGate: Keep temporal/multi-head representation; replace hard conjunctive onset gate with a learned event-admission head or train-time-consistent event objective, then synthetic verify before any V6 real run.
designImplicationsIfConfirmed.ifHeadsPoorlyDiscriminative: Revisit auxiliary target construction/imbalance and shared temporal training before retaining V5 architecture.
designImplicationsIfConfirmed.ifTaskWeightingDominates: Remove learned homoscedastic weighting in favor of frozen explicit loss weights or gradient-balanced training validated synthetically.
designImplicationsIfConfirmed.ifBoundarySupervisionMaterial: Use overlap/context-aware sequence training or carry causal hidden state across adjacent training chunks without leaking validation information.
